title: Origin story: Guan Yu
description: Guan Yu was the general of Shu Han in the Three Kingdoms era, sworn brother to Liu Bei and Zhang Fei in the peach garden oath. Famed for his loyalty, his long beard, and his Green Dragon Crescent Blade, he was deified after death and is worshipped as the god of war, loyalty, and righteousness.
